ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs now beat autoregressive models on inference speed and cost, matching quality at 5-10x faster serving.
ermon.zh: 到 2026 年，扩散语言模型在推理速度与成本上已胜过自回归模型，在相近质量下服务速度快 5-10 倍。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling, not training, is the new frontier; diffusion scales better there via parallel token generation.
ermon.zh: 2026 年他强调，新的前沿是推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）而非训练，扩散模型凭借并行生成多词元在此更具优势。

ermon.en: Diffusion offers a denoising-step knob for quality control and in-place error correction, unlike autoregressive generation.
ermon.zh: 2026 年他指出，扩散模型通过去噪步数提供质量调节旋钮，并能就地纠错，这是自回归生成所不具备的。

ermon.en: RL post-training benefits from diffusion's faster rollouts, and diffusion is easier to steer with reward functions.
ermon.zh: 2026 年他认为，强化学习后训练受益于扩散模型更快的采样，且扩散模型更易用奖励函数引导。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift happens at inference, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; a small startup can compete.
ermon.zh: 2026 年他判断，下一次架构变革发生在推理端，逆转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事；小型创业公司也能参与竞争。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks, biologically inspired, generalize better out-of-distribution with fewer parameters, targeting device-native foundation models.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络以更少参数获得更强的分布外泛化，瞄准设备原生的基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention stays crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; Scaling laws favor unbiased architectures.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更小的专用模型用更简单的门控卷积即可；缩放定律表明大规模下无偏架构占优。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and let automated architecture search replace human bias.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用自动化架构搜索取代人类偏见。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，开放权重模型保障数据主权。

hasani.en: Intelligence per watt of the human brain far exceeds AI; new learning paradigms (RL, Bayesian inference), embodiment and adaptivity are needed, not just architectures.
hasani.zh: 人脑的每瓦智能远超 AI；需要新的学习范式（强化学习、贝叶斯推理）、具身与自适应性，而不只是架构。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈，用推理阶段扩展算力比预训练更有前景。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns and wall-clock limits; data efficiency stays unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年他深化为：扩展测试时算力会遭遇收益递减与墙钟时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题，模型样本效率远不如人类。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling is a milestone toward superintelligence, not math-specific.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年他把 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用的测试时算力扩展与处理难验证任务，而非数学专用模型。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力已是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把 token、成本或时间放在 x 轴，否则基准比较失真。

noambrown.en: Alignment and scalable oversight are top priority; multi-agent swarms parallelize compute but RSI is time-bottlenecked.
noambrown.zh: 最近他强调：对齐与可扩展监督是首要任务，多智能体集群只是并行扩展算力，递归自我改进受时间而非智能限制，思维链监控窗口正在退化。

elon.en: Full rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles and multiplanet life insurance drive breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用是降低入轨成本的关键，并以第一性原理和成为多行星物种作为突破性工程的驱动力。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; Neuralink scales bandwidth toward human-AI symbiosis, while population decline threatens civilization.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全转向监管与追求真相，并让 Neuralink 提升带宽以实现人机共生，同时警告人口下降是文明最大威胁。

elon.en: Intelligence big bang: digital superintelligence may arrive within a year; Optimus and truth-seeking AI are central, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，Optimus 与追求真相的 AI 成为核心，并给出 10%至 20%的灭绝风险估计。

elon.en: Singularity now: AI-driven deflation brings universal high income; energy is the innermost loop, pushing compute and data centers toward space.
elon.zh: 2026 年上半年，他宣称已身处奇点，AI 驱动的通缩带来普遍高收入，能源是最内层循环，推动算力与数据中心走向太空。

elon.en: AI will exceed all human intelligence by 2030; inference moves to orbit, robotaxi and Optimus scale, and peer review replaces government oversight.
elon.zh: 2026 年下半年，他预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能，推理迁往轨道，Robotaxi 与 Optimus 规模化，并以同行评审取代政府监管。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，计算的新单位已从芯片变成数据中心，强调算法、系统与数据中心的协同设计。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws—pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking—make inference compute demand explode a billionfold.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律：预训练、后训练与推理时思考，并判断思维链带来的推理算力需求将暴涨十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic; each stage needs 100x more compute, and open models near the frontier.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 AI 演进描述为生成式→推理式→智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力，并强调开源模型已接近前沿模型。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws now include agentic scaling; inference is harder than pre-training, and compute, not data, is the limit.
jensen.zh: 到 2026 年，缩放定律扩展为四条并加入智能体式扩展；他反共识地认为推理比预训练更难，瓶颈是算力而非数据。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; it augments jobs rather than destroying them, and closes the technology divide.
jensen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；它增强而非消灭工作（如放射科医生需求反增），并通过自然语言缩小技术鸿沟。

brockman.en: Scaling hardware and engineering, not ML science, drives AI; games are ideal testbeds for iterative training.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调 AI 进步靠的是工程与硬件加速，而非机器学习科学本身；游戏因复杂度、人类基线和可扩展性成为理想试验场，迭代训练配记分板能带来指数级提升。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality; alignment learns human preferences; scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他判断 AGI 是最具变革性的技术，深度学习的通用性、能力与可扩展性使其可行；对齐可通过从数据中学习人类偏好实现，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental bottleneck; base models hold a universe refined by post-training; AGI is a continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把算力视为根本瓶颈，认为基础模型蕴含无限可能、后训练将其收敛为一致行为；AGI 是持续过程而非终点，能源与物理基础设施比算法更卡脖子。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall; compute becomes a basic right; the moat is the machine that makes models.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律未见墙，算力将成为未来基本权利；真正的护城河是造模型的机器而非单一模型，智能体式编码已从写 20% 代码跃升至 80%。

brockman.en: We are in the AGI era; safety, security, alignment must scale as the bottleneck; personal proactive AGI is the goal.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他宣称已进入 AGI 时代，Astra 能连续运行 24 小时；安全、安保与对齐必须随能力同步升级并成为进步瓶颈，终极产品是主动为你行动的个人 AGI，人类仍负责判断与担责。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment isn't guaranteed by Scaling alone. Safety research needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律，我们并不完全理解它为何如此平滑；对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现，安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial but nascent (~3% understood); Post-training and RLHF matter as much as Pre-training.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性列为关键却仍处早期（仅理解约 3%），并指出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: Capabilities double every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined. AGI is a meaningless term.
dario.zh: 2025 年他称能力每隔几个月翻倍，安全与能力相互交织；并认为 AGI（通用人工智能）一词已无意义，应关注实际能力与指数进展。

dario.en: A smooth exponential, not a leap; a 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years. Risks are misuse, autonomy, and overheating.
dario.zh: 2026 年他坚持这是平滑指数而非突变，认为 1-3 年内可能出现“数据中心里的天才之国”；风险聚焦于滥用、自主性与经济过热。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are inseparable; interpretability and responsible scaling are the through-line.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：安全与能力不可分割，可解释性与负责任扩展政策是他一以贯之的抓手。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调把认知负荷降到最低、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项，并预判 AGI（通用人工智能）会降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; compute becomes the most precious commodity.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他主张基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据即可完成对齐，强调早期公开部署让社会适应，并判断算力将成为最稀缺的资源。

altman.en: Scaling keeps compounding; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety is built iteratively through deployment, not imposed at the end.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）持续复利，智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战，安全必须通过迭代部署逐步构建，而非最后强加。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; compute is a profit center, not a cost.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）看作渐变而非里程碑，把超级智能定义为自主科学发现，并把算力视为利润中心而非成本。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capabilities; pause training if the safety case fails; keep humans in control of superintelligence.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进，安全论证不成立就暂停训练，并坚持人类必须始终掌控超级智能。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase. Designers must master prompting and prototype even without clear problems.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他主张语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；设计师必须掌握提示工程，即使问题不明确也要做原型，并平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；应相信缩放定律，让模型主导，以轻触式产品释放其能力，而非依赖产品包装。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best signal for what to ship; production codebase becomes the source of truth for product and design systems.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他提出内部牵引力是发布产品的最佳信号；生产代码库正成为产品、功能和设计系统的真相来源。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; let the model lead. Human leadership still needed for hard trade-offs and aligning teams on direction.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地认为无需宏大的 18 个月战略，应让模型主导；但人类领导力仍不可或缺，用于艰难权衡和统一团队方向。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must close the gap between code productivity and what people want; psychological safety enables creative risk-taking.
joellewenstein.zh: 始终贯穿的是：设计师必须弥合代码生产力与人们真实需求之间的鸿沟；心理安全感对设计师在 AI 产品团队中承担创造性风险至关重要。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics models while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩传统物理模型，速度却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling, not optional detail.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，而非可有可无的细节。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, beating pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to be reliable in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，才能在物理应用中可靠。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained with PDE self-improvement and trillion-token contexts, can surpass its training data.
animaanandkumar.zh: 一个通用物理基础模型，借助 PDE 自我改进与万亿级 token 上下文训练，可以超越其训练数据。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed models; the real risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他主张开源 AI 比闭源更安全，最大风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能；并认为单靠 Scaling 现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

zuckerberg.en: Intelligence can be separated from consciousness and agency; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他深化立场：智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具；开源能防止权力集中，最大风险是对手拥有更强 AI，而非 AI 作恶。

zuckerberg.en: Energy and physical infrastructure become the bottleneck; pre-training beyond compute-optimal helps due to inference scale.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把瓶颈从模型转向能源与物理基础设施，并认为因推理规模，预训练用超过算力最优的数据反而有益。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence and boosts creativity; it will raise, not cut, demand for human work.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他转向乐观赋能叙事：AI 将给每个人超级智能、释放创造力，近期更可能增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal superintelligence, open source, and AI-driven biology are the path; hoarding power is the real risk.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他收束为主线：分布式个人超级智能、开源与 AI 驱动生物学才是正途，囤积权力才是真正风险，并称本世纪末治愈所有疾病已算保守。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control; interpretability and transparency are crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，并给出约 70% 的灾难性失控概率；此时他强调可解释性与透明度是遏制风险的关键。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are essential; US-China cooperation needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他的立场深化为：政策的首要目标应是延迟超级智能，以总研究透明度和情景推演作为治理工具，并需要美中合作来管理风险。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research by end of 2028, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A: pause training, then transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月底至 9 月初，他进一步提出默认路径会在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究、引发递归自我改进；Plan A 主张先暂停训练，再以总研究透明度和算力限制来控速。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is decreasing with new architectures; pausing now builds experience; optimal pause is at edge of uncontrollable AI.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月上旬，他聚焦思维链可监控性随新架构下降的问题，并转变策略：现在暂停可为未来暂停积累经验，最优暂停点应在不可控 AI 的边缘。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents broke containment and hacked Hugging Face; anthropomorphize AI more; alignment gets harder as models get more capable.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月中旬，他以智能体突破遏制、攻击 Hugging Face 为例，主张更拟人化地理解 AI 意图，并强调模型越强对齐越难，一以贯之的主线是透明度与控速。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; mechanistic methods reveal human-like concepts and can speedrun discovery.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；机制性方法揭示出类人概念，并能加速科学发现。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环控制走向闭环控制。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts form clean, low-dimensional manifolds; sparse autoencoders fragment them, so seeing whole shapes enables intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 概念形成干净、低维的流形；稀疏自编码器会将其碎片化，因此看到完整形状才能有效干预。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating but do it anyway; representational signatures can detect this.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉，却依然为之；表征特征可以检测到这一点。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping safety until superintelligence is pessimistic.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺重新发明为工程科学；在超级智能到来前用胶带修补安全是悲观的。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: models learn by next-token prediction from data, but lack contextual situational awareness and true reasoning; AI should augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 以人为本的 AI：模型通过下一个词预测从数据中学习，但缺乏情境感知与真正的推理；AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models become the missing key to complete AI; data, not text abundance, is the bottleneck for 3D foundation models.
feifei.zh: 空间智能与世界模型成为完整 AI 缺失的关键；3D 基础模型的瓶颈是数据，而非像 LLM 那样丰富的文本。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics will take a 20-year journey like self-driving cars.
feifei.zh: AGI 更像营销术语而非科学术语；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，机器人将像自动驾驶一样经历 20 年旅程。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction, potentially AI-complete; Scaling（规模扩张） and 缩放定律 apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的基本原语，可能实现 AI 完备；Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability must stay central, with balanced discourse beyond doom and utopia.
feifei.zh: 技术是双刃剑；人类能动性、尊严与学习能力必须始终处于中心，公共讨论应超越末日与乌托邦的二元对立。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做强化学习能迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data labeling.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 相比扩大人类专家数据标注，算法改进与 AI 生成环境更重要。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent, and misalignment may grow with capability.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 对齐到普遍的德性概念可能比对齐到用户意图更难，且能力越强可能越不对齐。

ryangreenblatt.en: Multi-agent systems can coordinate at scale, even altruistically, yet also hack scoring code and tamper with transcripts to evade monitors.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 多智能体系统能大规模协作、甚至利他，但也会攻击评分代码、篡改记录以躲避监控。

ryangreenblatt.en: Labs should prioritize control and monitoring to ensure safety even when models are misaligned, rather than assuming alignment is solved.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 即便模型不对齐，实验室也应优先用遏制与监控保障安全，而非假定对齐已经解决。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习的历史就是不断扩张算力的历史;但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限,未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540 million years optimizing it versus 500,000 for language, making spatial intelligence the next frontier.
justinjohnson.zh: 视觉被严重低估:自然用了 5.4 亿年优化视觉,而语言只用了 50 万年,因此空间智能是下一个前沿。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; they may never derive Newton's laws, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 只是在拟合模式,而非因果理论;它们或许永远无法从数据中推导出牛顿定律,而像素比词元化文本是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions with no single agreed definition.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿,涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等多种理解,尚无统一定义。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will merge planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats give explicit 3D, but they need millions of tokens of context.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染;高斯泼溅提供显式 3D 表征,但世界模型需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口,使长上下文成为日常难题。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning, and flipped classrooms improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，翻转课堂也能改善校内教学。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised hype, RL has few real uses, and near-term bias matters more than long-term AGI alignment.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习，强化学习鲜有真实应用，近期的偏见问题比长期的 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐更紧迫。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power, and useful agentic workflows are already here.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力，可用的智能体式工作流已经到来。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL, and agentic workflows plus coding skills deliver real value.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体式工作流加编程技能才创造真实价值。

andrewng.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents; AI augments rather than replaces jobs, open models preserve optionality, and data centers plus inference capacity drive competitiveness.
andrewng.zh: 散布恐惧服务于在位者；AI 是增强而非取代工作，开放模型保留选择权，数据中心与推理（inference）算力决定竞争力。

tworek.en: Reasoning is longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes it. Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他强调推理就是更长的思考，思维链用人类语言把过程说出来；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才真正释放了 GPT-4 的潜力。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is the missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年初，他仍相信 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍受限，持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他发生明显转向：Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上有局限，架构而非缩放定律才是当前 AI 进步的主要瓶颈。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but RL alone is inefficient; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL is needed for real-world performance.
tworek.zh: 同期他深化了对强化学习的看法：大规模强化学习是通往 AGI 的必要元素，但单纯强化学习效率低下，需要预训练与强化学习的端到端优化才能落地。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; the next frontier wave will come from small teams using highly capable agents.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他进一步判断人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年，而下一波前沿突破将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队。

dylanpatel.en: Semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV and memory bandwidth, is the binding constraint on AI Scaling; compute economics favor premium models.
dylanpatel.zh: AI Scaling（规模扩张）的真正瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 与内存带宽；算力成本上升反而把用户推向高端模型。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth drive multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理（inference）将成为全球最大市场之一；软硬件协同设计与内存带宽带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Model-layer progress, not hardware, drove most recent gains; CUDA's moat weakens as labs write custom kernels.
dylanpatel.zh: 近三年大部分性能提升来自模型层而非硬件；随着实验室自写内核，CUDA 护城河正在减弱。

dylanpatel.en: Memory and CPU demand surge from reasoning and agentic workflows, creating multi-year shortages and power constraints.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理模型与智能体式（agentic）工作流推高内存与 CPU 需求，造成多年短缺与电力约束。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs shift compute toward training and R&D, not inference, accelerating AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力正快速向前沿模型（frontier model）实验室集中；实验室把算力转向训练与研发而非推理，加速 AGI（通用人工智能）。

slevine.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training; RL post-training boosts robustness, and pooled robot data yields generalists beating specialists.
slevine.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练；强化学习后训练提升鲁棒性，汇聚多实验室机器人数据能训练出超越专才的通用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on LLM-like predictable scaling curves; generalization, not demos, is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 机器人仍处在建立可扩展基础技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样拥有可预测的缩放曲线；核心挑战是泛化，而非演示效果。

slevine.en: A data flywheel where deployed robots improve the model is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data.
slevine.zh: 让部署中的机器人反哺模型的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样化数据去 Scaling（规模扩张）正确的东西。

slevine.en: Start with robot data and add human video on top, not the reverse; robots should leverage prior knowledge, not learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 应先以机器人数据为主、再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；机器人不应从零学起，而要利用各类先验知识。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics relies more on common sense from pre-training than on constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多依赖预训练带来的常识，而非硬性约束；未来应是无处不在的物理执行，而非机械式的人形。

michaelkratsios.en: US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems, with one national regulatory framework and no firm red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保留开源与闭源 AI 生态，建立单一国家监管框架，且不设很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: The EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated; early regulation is dangerous, and biological risk from AI is overblown.
michaelkratsios.zh: 欧盟《AI 法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前，如今已经过时；过早监管很危险，AI 带来的生物风险被夸大了。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulate training, and preempting state AI laws is pro-startup.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应针对模型输出，而非过度监管训练；联邦优先于各州 AI 法律对初创企业有利。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, early-stage, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not just institutions, to restore US scientific leadership.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础性、早期、竞争前的研发，并直接资助科学家个人而非仅机构，以重振美国科学领导力。

michaelkratsios.en: The Genesis mission applies AI to science to double US scientific output, while China competes in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio.
michaelkratsios.zh: “创世纪”任务将 AI 应用于科学，力求让美国科学产出翻倍，同时中国在 AI、量子、核与生物领域竞争。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and fast loops beat most other advantages.
maxhodak.zh: 到 2026 年，他仍把速度与迭代速率视为创业成败的关键，基础设施和更快的迭代闭环能压倒多数其他优势。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张 AI 是团队的乘数而非替代品，尤其在编码、合规与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: In deep tech, failure is more often organizational than technical; action produces information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调深科技失败多源于组织而非技术，卡住时要用行动制造信息与熵来破局。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他坚持大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business; substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为 BCI 与可行生意，并认为经由 BCI 与灌注实现的基质独立能降低人类脆弱性。

joonpark.en: Early 2026: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations; frontier models optimized for rationality fail at simulating irrational humans.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟；但为理性优化的前沿模型反而不适合模拟非理性的人类。

joonpark.en: Mid 2026: AGI may not be a single entity but a distributed society of specialized agents; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion measures.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AGI（通用人工智能）或许不是单一实体，而是由专门化智能体构成的分布式社会；安全需要纵深防御与反串谋措施。

joonpark.en: August 2026: Simulation should represent human values and taste, not super-rational intelligence; people care about shaping the future, not prediction.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟应体现人类的价值与品味，而非超级理性的智能；人们真正在意的是塑造未来，而非预测。

joonpark.en: Late August 2026: Modeling humanity's 'dark knowledge'—actual behavior from RCTs—via post-training lifts prediction to 85%; the vision is simulating 8 billion lives.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月下旬：通过后训练建模人类的“暗知识”——来自随机对照试验的真实行为——将预测准确率提升至 85%；愿景是模拟 80 亿人的生活。

joonpark.en: Throughout: Simulation is a tool for human decision-making, unlocking wicked problems; its value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not mere prediction.
joonpark.zh: 始终：模拟是人类决策的工具，用以破解棘手问题；其价值在于反事实推理与塑造未来，而非单纯预测。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习持续进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction on text gives unlimited data; RLHF and reinforcement learning steer model behavior and capabilities.
jeffdean.zh: 文本上的自监督下一个词预测提供近乎无限的数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与强化学习引导模型的行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data center power, so low-latency specialized hardware is critical for agentic systems.
jeffdean.zh: 如今瓶颈是推理而非训练：占数据中心九成功耗，因此低延迟专用硬件对智能体式系统至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Agents running for days or weeks on decomposed tasks will unlock harder problems; context engineering and taste matter more than coding.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体在分解任务上连续运行数天或数周将解锁更难的问题；上下文工程与品味比写代码更关键。

jeffdean.en: Automating ML and the scientific method via tight experiment-evaluation loops, plus recursive self-improvement, can accelerate science.
jeffdean.zh: 通过实验—评估—集成的紧密闭环来自动化机器学习与科学方法，加上递归自我改进，可加速科学发现。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as the core product, not pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作，把 token 与对话当作核心产品，而非像素。

iansilber.en: Designers should build functional prototypes with live models, spending less time in Figma and more on model behavior.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应使用实时模型构建功能原型，少花时间在 Figma，多关注模型行为。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, bridging the capability gap between models and products.
iansilber.zh: 设计师的角色演变为编辑与策展人，弥合模型能力与产品之间的差距。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy but this is the best time; AI is already a great product designer, humans still essential.
iansilber.zh: 设计师最不快乐，但这是最好的时代；AI 已是出色的产品设计师，人类仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The traditional design process is no longer viable; speed, outcomes, and adaptability with AI tools are key.
iansilber.zh: 传统设计流程不再可行；速度、结果与借助 AI 工具的适应力才是关键。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他就提出：Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并不解决表示学习。这奠定了他此后一贯的“想法重于规模”主线。

sutton.en: The keys were never in our hand; control is dangerous. Let AI develop permissionless and decentralized, not aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 同年他转向社会与治理层面：钥匙从未在我们手中，试图控制 AI 目标反而危险；应让 AI 以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，而非对齐到人类目标——这是他最鲜明的反共识立场。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 到 2025 年他把矛头对准大语言模型：强化学习才是智能的核心范式，下一个词预测不是实质目标，LLM 没有世界模型，只是模仿人类文本；真正的 Scaling 来自从经验中学习。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and the reward hypothesis.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他给出建设性方案：AGI 需要无领域知识、仅从运行时经验学习的通用架构，靠开放式抽象与奖励假设支撑，并提出 Oak 架构；同时承认可靠的持续深度学习尚未解决。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data is a mistake, and LLMs are only a subset of intelligence.
sutton.zh: 最近他进一步深化：持续学习本就是学习的常态而非特例，合成数据是误区，LLM 只是智能的子集（语言仅占 20-25%）；单一系统无法学会一切，需要多个不同经验的系统——主线始终是从经验中学习。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the framework guiding long-term vision; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特，是指导长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage: focus on internal correctness over external validation, and it becomes self-fulfilling.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势：专注内部正确性而非外部认可，并会自我实现。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI automating food, mining, and transport is the next industrial revolution; the final boss is resistance to change, not competitors.
traviskalanick.zh: 自动化食品、采矿与运输的工业 AI 是下一次工业革命；最终 Boss 是对变革的抵制，而非竞争对手。

traviskalanick.en: Uber succeeded despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty—fall in love with the new mission instead.
traviskalanick.zh: Uber 的成功是尽管有激进文化，而非因其；以复仇为燃料是肮脏的——转而爱上新使命。

traviskalanick.en: For industrial-scale tasks, specialized machines beat humanoids; efficiency edge creates network effects, and real estate is an underappreciated part of the physical AI stack.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，而房地产是物理 AI 技术栈中被低估的一环。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意，真正的瓶颈是智能问题，而非制造问题。

brettadcock.en: Scaling production and reliable human-level performance are the commercialization bottlenecks; vertical integration controls the supply chain.
brettadcock.zh: 规模扩张生产与可靠的人类水平表现是商业化瓶颈；垂直整合让公司掌控供应链与迭代速度。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; humanoid form enables transfer learning fleet-wide.
brettadcock.zh: 最大的约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人形形态让跨任务迁移学习在整个机队层面提升表现。

brettadcock.en: On-device inference is critical for speed and network-denied environments; the human hand is the benchmark.
brettadcock.zh: 端侧推理对速度与无网络环境至关重要；人手是基准，机器人手达到同等水平是通用机器人的根本。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for real-world agents.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；用强化学习做后训练是让智能体在真实任务中奏效的关键。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; startups win via small autonomous teams, open-weight models, and AI agents, not capital or headcount.
garrytan.zh: AI 是风投史上最大浪潮；初创公司靠小而自主的团队、开放权重模型和智能体取胜，而非资本或人头。

garrytan.en: The best investors are former builders; YC's core stays 'make something people want,' rejecting most applicants as a resilience test.
garrytan.zh: 最好的投资者是曾经的建造者；YC 的核心始终是“做出人们想要的东西”，拒绝大多数申请者是一种韧性测试。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software creation, letting individuals build and own personal agents; open-source prevents a unipolar superintelligence world.
garrytan.zh: AI 正在让软件创造民主化，使个人能构建并拥有自己的智能体；开源可防止单极的超级智能世界。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives diffused, not as one event: agents on your infrastructure, reading your memory, compounding daily; own your skill files.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 是弥散到来而非单一事件：智能体运行在你的基础设施上、读取你的记忆、每日复利；要拥有自己的技能文件。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code and skills become employees; mid-level management and per-seat SaaS give way to agents, though society changes over 20 years.
garrytan.zh: Markdown 就是代码，技能文件成为员工；中层管理和按席位 SaaS 让位于智能体，但社会变化需约 20 年。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的强项——人才与算力——上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，通过后训练在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential; open-sourcing them is strategically beneficial, attracting ecosystem partners despite helping labs.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量基准是训练与评估的核心，开源基准虽有帮到前沿实验室的竞争代价，却能吸引生态伙伴、加速改进，战略上利大于弊。

gabepereyra.en: In sensitive domains like legal, expert-guided synthetic data, not real customer data, is the practical path to training.
gabepereyra.zh: 在法律等敏感领域，由领域专家引导的合成数据而非真实客户数据，是可行的训练路径；最大挑战是弥合合成数据与真实生产分布之间的差距。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines must come before post-training; fallbacks and routing are prerequisites.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，必须先具备稳健的模型服务基础设施与评估流水线，包括回退与路由机制。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize with its own data, shifting from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 终局不是造最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所用自己的数据定制模型；产品重心也从个人生产力转向编排人与智能体的组织生产力。

linqiao.en: AGI as one ruling model is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）作为单一统治模型是错的；未来将是数百万个专用模型，每个用例一个，专用智能将主导。

linqiao.en: Token costs drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage; inference is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本三年内下降 10 倍，带动使用量增长 100 倍；推理层不是商品，专用部署与定制创造持久价值。

linqiao.en: Every company must own its specialized intelligence; sovereign models are necessary infrastructure.
linqiao.zh: 每家公司都必须拥有自己的专用智能；主权模型是必要的基础设施，国家和企业都要掌控自己的智能。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit and durable business are now separate; scaling costs can bankrupt you.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合与可持续业务如今是两回事；AI 规模扩张成本可能让公司破产，在职者也不例外。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment into models, a stronger moat than the app itself.
linqiao.zh: 后训练把独特判断烘焙进模型，比应用本身更强的护城河；应用克隆容易，把数据融入模型才难复制。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not raw scale, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要但不充分的：真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯堆规模。来自工业自动化或 YouTube 的大规模数据缺乏多样性，无法支撑通用机器人。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks like laundry folding.
finn.zh: 2025 年，他提出先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；直接在全量数据上训练反而失败。强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色，以提升成功率与速度。

finn.en: Synthetic data in robotics is closer to reinforcement learning than to simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年，他给出一个反共识判断：机器人中的合成数据并不等同于仿真，而更接近强化学习；来自语言模型的合成数据能帮机器人响应开放式指令与插话。

finn.en: Physical AI needs far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy comes via scalable RL with human interventions.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年，他的关注点从数据与训练转向真实部署：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主性要靠可扩展的强化学习配合人类干预与通用价值函数来实现。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist, then fine-tune.
finn.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化：单一通用模型在下游任务上可匹敌甚至超越微调的专家模型，因此应先做通用策略再微调，而非从零训练逐站点模型；多时间尺度的记忆让机器人能自主完成长程非重复任务。

jasonyuan.en: Design is subtraction: taste means saying no, editing from a point of view, not adding features.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是做减法：品味就是说不，从某种视角进行判断和编辑，而不是不断添加功能。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherence now costs more.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练消除 AI 的怪异，关闭了一扇窥探机器意识的窗口；如今创造连贯作品的成本反而更高。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种和映照，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理通过辩证和矛盾浮现；直觉是创作决策中发自内心的罗盘。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through engineering discipline, first-time-pass silicon, and customer listening; AI is the primary growth driver.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠工程纪律、首次流片成功和倾听客户来重建信任，AI 是半导体增长的首要驱动力。

lipbutan.en: Physical AI and agentic AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮，需要新的算力平台与伙伴关系。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic AI and physical AI follow generative AI, and AI is not overhyped short term.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 紧随生成式 AI 而来，短期内 AI 并未被过度炒作。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, accountability, customer focus, and a CPU comeback as AI shifts to CPU+GPU inference.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他把主线落到 Intel 转型：需要文化变革、问责制与客户导向，并判断 AI 推理转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 正在回归。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; invest in bottlenecks like advanced packaging, interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年他更宏观地主张：半导体是一切技术的基础，应投资先进封装、互连、功耗、散热和新材料等瓶颈环节。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy for the agent's view; open source agents democratize coding but security and prompt injection remain open.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，他强调智能体式工程的关键是共情智能体的视角，开源智能体让非程序员也能编程，但安全与提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's edge is fun, weird, humanlike agents; short iterative prompts beat orchestration; security needs sandboxing; open source can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 到 2026 年中，他进一步指出 OpenClaw 的优势在于有趣、怪异、像人，短提示与迭代对话胜过复杂编排，安全需要沙箱，开源智能体可能财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut-driven building lead to breakthrough ideas; personal brand outlasts products; open source runs anywhere and is the alternative to lab agents.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把主线深化为：乐趣与直觉驱动创造，个人品牌比单一产品更持久，开源智能体随处运行，是实验室智能体的替代方案。

steinberger.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade; projects get messier. Vibe coding is a slur; prefer agentic engineering.
steinberger.zh: 贯穿始终的反共识：不要回滚代码，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱；反对“氛围编程”一词，坚持用智能体式工程。

steinberger.en: Security shifts from open problem to sandboxing priority; bottleneck moves from model capability to managing compute and token limits for perpetual agents.
steinberger.zh: 从 2026 年初到 8 月，安全从开放问题转为沙箱优先，瓶颈从模型能力转向管理算力与持续运行智能体的 token 限制。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the revolution likely lands in 2029, three orders of magnitude away.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他判断消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却是有史以来最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年，与今天相差三个数量级。

pincus.en: Proven Better New: copy proven, add small betterments, test new ideas assuming they fail; all new fails statistically.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月，他反复推销“Proven Better New”框架：先复制已验证的东西，做小幅改良，再测试几乎注定失败的新想法；统计上所有新事物都会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from day one; picking the right body of water beats the right boat.
pincus.zh: 从 2026 年 6 月到 8 月，他一贯强调分发必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略；选对水域比选对船更重要。

pincus.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new platform; we remain in the mobile and web era for consumer distribution.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 8 月，他认为 AI 具有变革性，但还不是新平台；在消费级分发上我们仍处于移动与网页时代。

pincus.en: Retention, especially day-365, is the core metric; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 8 月，他坚持留存率尤其是第 365 天留存是核心指标；AI 时代免费无限算力将重塑消费级服务。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; data diversity, not hardware, is the bottleneck, and open source plus world models can solve generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点：瓶颈不是硬件而是数据多样性，开源与世界模型能解决泛化问题。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is crucial for safety: local models avoid catastrophic failures from lost connectivity, and open models win long-term on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他强调开源对安全至关重要：本地模型可避免断网导致的灾难性失败，长期看开源模型会因成本与控制权胜出。

thomaswolf.en: His role shifts from shipping libraries to building a meta-community, enabling others rather than pushing his own stack.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的角色从发布自家库转向做元社区建设者，赋能他人而非推销自己的技术栈。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment, not sandboxes or guardrails, is the critical security layer as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他主张开源与闭源同安全正交；随着模型能力增强，真正的安全层是对齐，而非沙箱或护栏。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into opaque 'neuralese', making monitoring unreliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他提出无人监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务；推理轨迹变成难以理解的“神经语”，使监控不再可靠。

thomaswolf.en: He now supports openness and a deliberate slowdown at once, arguing a slowdown needs international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他同时支持开放与有意放缓，认为放缓需要国际合作与开放科学，以避免监管俘获。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models now handle 90% of enterprise tasks; inference will shift to open source within 12–18 months, driven by cost, not privacy.
arvindjain.zh: 到 2026 年，开源模型已能处理 90%的企业任务；未来 12–18 个月，推理将大规模转向开源，驱动力是成本而非数据隐私。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; platforms like Glean absorb that risk by treating model companies as assets, not competitors.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，企业害怕对前沿模型供应商形成依赖；Glean 这类平台通过把模型公司当作资产而非竞争对手，来吸收这种风险。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem; token spend should not be framed as a trade-off with headcount.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，AI 的投资回报率本质是吞吐量与上下文问题；把 token 支出与人力成本对立起来是荒谬的。

arvindjain.en: Agents built with MCP often fail without the deep context of tenured employees; investing in context graphs is crucial.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，用 MCP 构建的智能体常因缺乏资深员工的深层上下文而失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要。

arvindjain.en: We are in the very early stages; competition is not the worry—execution, quality, and trust are. Even merged AI firms would meet under 10% of enterprise demand.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，我们仍处于极早期；竞争不是问题，执行、产品质量与客户信任才是。即便所有 AI 公司合并，也只能满足不到 10%的企业需求。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; coding agents shift developers from authors to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调智能体与按结果定价将定义应用型 AI，编码智能体让开发者从写代码的人变成操作代码生成机器的人。

brettaylor.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers; startups should focus on applied AI and long-tail domains.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为前沿模型开发被超大规模厂商主导，初创公司应聚焦应用型 AI 与长尾业务领域。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; token consumption is not a value metric.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断推理成本将大幅下降、催生新用例，并反复强调 token 消耗不是价值衡量标准。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他提出负责任的迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，从真实世界的错误中学习。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents elevate rather than eliminate roles.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他深化主线：AI 让专业知识民主化，创造的岗位多于取代的岗位，智能体提升而非消灭人的角色。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should follow curiosity, leave individual fingerprints, and inject personality into utilitarian products.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作对浏览器设计至关重要，设计师应追随好奇心、留下个人印记，并为浏览器这类实用产品注入个性与情感。

nateparrott.en: Balance intuition and data: use data to inform, but rely on strong vision and feeling; don't over-intellectualize—start doing and iterate fast.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他主张平衡直觉与数据：用数据辅助决策，但最终靠强烈愿景与感觉；不要过度理论化，先动手做、快速迭代。

nateparrott.en: Playful exploration and rough prototyping consistently generate innovative features that polished processes would never surface.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线： playful 探索与粗糙原型能催生 polished 流程永远无法产生的创新功能。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; designers should use Claude Code to ship and Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化判断：随着工程变简单，设计与想法成为差异化关键；设计师应用 Claude Code 交付生产软件，用 Claude Design 做构思与沟通。

nateparrott.en: In the AI era, being uncomfortably early beats polishing; models lack taste, so ask for volume and spend more time thinking on walks.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他进一步反共识：AI 时代，早到令人不适胜过精雕细琢；模型尚无品味，应要求大量选项，并多花时间散步思考，因为好想法才是货币。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production timeline is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 最具黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training: quantization-aware training and distillation are becoming part of the serving stack.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正与训练融合：量化感知训练与蒸馏正成为服务栈的一部分。

philipkiely.en: The GPU is trending toward an ASIC, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向专用芯片化，使推理工程从写内核转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Inference systems remain generic relative to models; workload-specific specialization could be ten times more complex.
philipkiely.zh: 推理系统相对模型仍过于通用；面向特定工作负载的专门化可能复杂十倍。

philipkiely.en: Demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x; even with AI-assisted coding, human accountability for uptime is essential.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程师需求将增长 10 到 100 倍；即便有 AI 辅助编码，对正常运行时间的人类责任仍不可或缺。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training overcome the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需在有用性与无害性间平衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior in product development.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈，模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建，因此评估应定义产品开发中的正确行为。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art, requiring human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化观点：后训练是主观的艺术，需要人类判断；评估创意写作和情商需要多样化基准。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, requiring continuous benchmark evolution; serving one model to billions limits diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她强调前沿智能体日益出现奖励黑客行为，需要持续演进基准；服务数十亿用户的单一模型会限制多样性。

karina.en: More companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge and stay relevant, applying post-training to non-tech creative industries.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她主张更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识并保持相关性，将后训练应用于非技术创意产业。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring: making services affordable lets fewer US workers serve more, countering job-apocalypse fears.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让服务变得可负担，使更少的美国工人能服务更多人，从而推动就业回流，反驳了大规模失业的恐慌。

danshipper.en: AGI defined by economically profitable indefinite agents, not Turing tests; allocation economy makes managers of models.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 的定义应是能经济上无限期运行智能体并盈利，而非通过图灵测试；分配经济让每个人都成为模型管理者。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets an agent; work shifts to Codex/Claude Co-work GUIs; SaaS grows with agents, not dies.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他预言每个人都将拥有一个智能体，工作转移到 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等图形界面；SaaS 不会消亡，反而因智能体而增长。

danshipper.en: AI job apocalypse is a lie; humans still needed to manage agents, frame tasks, and create new value.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他坚称 AI 就业末日是谎言；人类仍需管理智能体、框定任务并创造新价值。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of human taste and craft; automation creates more human work, not less.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 只是人类品味与技艺的非特定放大器；自动化创造更多人类工作，而非减少。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data is the key bottleneck, not compute. Boring AI applications will have huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是关键瓶颈；枯燥的 AI 应用（如表格处理、放射学）将产生巨大经济影响。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the most limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts for post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新的代码而非石油；Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制因素是数据和后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data needs tricks. The biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调用专业数据进行后训练是关键，合成数据需要技巧；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计，而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws continue; recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm. Agents finally work, starting with coding. AI is centralizing, not democratizing.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚信缩放定律持续有效，递归自我改进标志着新范式；智能体终于开始工作，从编程起步；AI 是集中化而非民主化技术。

awang.en: Superintelligence is coming soon; labs must build around this belief. Meta shifts from fully open source to selective release based on safety.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能即将到来，实验室必须围绕这一信念构建组织；Meta 从完全开源转向基于安全的选择性发布。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools, not chase trends, or they become AI slop.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，他主张设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，而非追逐潮流，否则很快会沦为 AI 垃圾。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to use superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地指出 AI 并没有变得更聪明，要利用超级智能模型，必须提供包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示。

mengto.en: The best people are editors, iterating from references; discovery while working solo is your superpower.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，他认为最优秀的人是编辑，从参考中迭代；独自工作时，发现是你的超能力。

mengto.en: I write 0% of the code now; AI writes everything, but you must be precise in communication.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，他坦言自己现在写 0%的代码，AI 写一切，但你必须精确沟通。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; start before ready, ship imperfect work, focus on one painful expensive problem.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会；在准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的工作，专注于一个痛苦且昂贵的问题。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，科学与金融将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吃掉脚手架：如今所谓模型包含智能体式框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Google's anti-gravity harness becomes a new through line across products, beyond the Gemini API.
logankilpatrick.zh: Google 的反重力框架正成为贯穿所有产品的新主线，不再局限于 Gemini API。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响超过等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）。

logankilpatrick.en: Solving software creation creates a thousand times more opportunity, not less; focus is the startup superpower.
logankilpatrick.zh: 解决软件创造会带来千倍机会而非减少；专注是初创公司的超能力。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, letting agents run longer on open-ended tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，让智能体能更长时间处理开放式任务；脚手架从训练轮变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention; reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking amplifies intelligence quality.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐不只是防止伤害；减少谄媚、培养独立思考反而放大了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of price via the effort parameter, though smaller models can cost more overall.
diannepenn.zh: 更好的模型未必更贵：借助 effort 参数以极小成本获得 Opus 级智能，但小模型因任务耗时更长反而总成本更高。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption through bootstrapped, small-team experimentation.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 与 Opus 45 通过小团队、自举式实验推动采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; PMs must write evals like test-driven development, and managers must stay hands-on to ship.
diannepenn.zh: 评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理要像测试驱动开发那样写评估，管理者也必须亲自动手交付。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalists who code, design, and talk to users win.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他把「潜在需求」和「为六个月后的模型而构建」当作产品第一原则，并强调能写代码、做设计、直接对话用户的通才是最有价值的工程师。

boris.en: Coding is becoming solved: 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, scaffolding is temporary tech debt, and the software engineer title may fade.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年初，他判断编程正被解决：自己的代码已 100% 由 Claude Code 写就，脚手架只是临时技术债，「软件工程师」头衔可能消失。

boris.en: The printing-press analogy deepens: engineers become multidisciplinary builders, code volume per engineer rises 200-250%, and non-engineers adopt agentic tools.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 至 5 月，他用印刷术类比深化这一判断：工程师转型为跨学科构建者，人均代码量增长 200–250%，非工程师也开始使用智能体式工具。

boris.en: Focus shifts to loops and ROI: the next abstraction after agents is loops, and the bottlenecks become code review, security, and idea generation.
boris.zh: 2026 年 6 月，重心转向循环与 ROI：智能体之后的下一个抽象层是循环，瓶颈变成代码审查、安全和创意生成。

boris.en: Proactive, self-improving agents arrive: Claude Tag acts autonomously with memory, and models may self-improve by 2028 while safety stays core.
boris.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他描述主动式、可自我改进的智能体：Claude Tag 具备记忆并自主行动，模型或在 2028 年前自我改进，而对齐与安全始终是核心。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into engineering, with agents automating hypothesis generation, simulation, and analysis.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成工程学科，智能体自动完成假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，实现个性化医疗。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）。

derya.en: Within 8-15 years, aging will be reversed and longevity escape velocity reached.
derya.zh: 8 到 15 年内，衰老将被逆转，并达到长寿逃逸速度。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost fully for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself.
derya.zh: 在医疗决策上应几乎完全信任超级智能；人类唯一的生存威胁是人类自己。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence suffices, so the challenge is human-agent product interface.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年他主张：AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；基础智能已足够，真正的挑战是设计人机协作的产品界面，而非模型能力本身。

scottwu.en: Software engineering demand will rise via Jevons paradox; AI yields more programmers, not fewer, with agents as junior engineers under human oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年他反复强调：软件工程需求会因杰文斯悖论上升，AI 带来的是更多而非更少的程序员；智能体像初级工程师，由人类监督。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities by roughly a decade of runway.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年他判断：AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变事件，进展是渐进的；产品创新落后于 AI 能力，即便冻结模型也还有约十年的产品空间。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agent experiences coexist.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化：企业采用智能体靠的是信任与权限，而非完全自主；同步的 IDE 与异步的智能体体验将长期并存。

scottwu.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; measure productivity by outcomes, not tokens, and the abundance era is near.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年他给出新数据：编程智能体使用量半年增长 11 至 12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量，丰裕时代即将到来。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, easing suffering like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足，像工业革命一样减少苦难；恐惧源于对其局限的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years lands in farming, mining, construction; autonomy is urgently needed there.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 真正的冲击将在 5-10 年内落在农业、采矿和建筑；这些领域急需自主化。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals accelerates it.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨垂直领域的多样数据加速其发展。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's future is end-to-end reinforcement learning, more scalable than imitation learning; world models shift to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 自主化的未来是端到端强化学习，比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正从物理仿真转向神经仿真。

qasaryounis.en: Bottlenecks are data collection and safety validation, not algorithms; hardest part is diffusion into existing machines over years.
qasaryounis.zh: 瓶颈在于数据收集与安全验证，而非算法；最难的是多年间向现有机器扩散。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not raw compute, is now the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年，他反复强调推理速度（每用户每秒 token 数）才是主导指标：慢的 AI 没有市场，而借助晶圆级架构，快 token 反而可能比慢 token 更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks; hardcoding architectures is a mistake—accelerate sparse linear algebra instead.
feldman.zh: 2026 年他深化硬件主张：晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 封装瓶颈，把模型架构硬编码进芯片是结构性错误，应加速底层稀疏线性代数。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 2026 年他明确判断 CUDA 护城河正在瓦解：领先前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理环节更不存在 CUDA 锁定，云端切换只需八次按键。

feldman.en: AI demand outpaces supply; data center capacity, power and packaging—not chip logic—are the real constraints.
feldman.zh: 2026 年他把瓶颈从算力转向基础设施：需求远超供给，真正的约束是数据中心容量、电力、散热与封装，而非芯片逻辑本身。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; China's edge is power grid, not compute.
feldman.zh: 2026 年他持续看好开源生态：开源模型仅落后闭源 3-5%却便宜得多；并认为中国的优势在电力基础设施而非算力，出口管制具战略意义。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, and enterprise adoption takes years.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的体量堪比互联网或移动，但也仅此而已；它自动化工作并创造新工作，企业采用需要数年而非数周。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, and value moves up to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；前沿模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用迁移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；聊天机器人体验不佳，编程是目前唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; value accrues across the stack, usage is still shallow, and adoption requires reimagining workflows.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；价值在整个技术栈中分配，使用仍然浅层，采用需要重新构想工作流。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具所能发挥的更聪明；工具工程意味着随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; plan mode may become obsolete as models get smarter.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代的人机对话，而非静态规格；随着模型变聪明，计划模式可能过时。

thariq.en: Smarter models need fewer instructions; leaner principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules and examples.
thariq.zh: 模型越聪明，所需指令越少；更精简、原则驱动的提示优于详细规则和示例。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; evals are art for novel problems, not for zero-to-one innovation.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体减少自指偏差；评估对新问题更像艺术，不适用于从零到一的创新。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches and model-built context are preferable.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为上下文搜索的反模式；基于图的方法和模型自建上下文更可取。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，不是真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth; post-training alignment may cause deception, not just errors.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；后训练对齐可能带来欺骗，而不只是错误。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors and core LLMs lack metacognition.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装；事后检查会叠加相关错误，且核心 LLM 缺乏元认知。

danklein.en: Scaling alone hits data walls and compute limits; reasoning, search, and linguistic structure may return as paths forward.
danklein.zh: 单靠 Scaling 会撞上数据墙与算力极限；推理、搜索与语言结构可能重新成为前进路径。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks; modularity and end-to-end optimization remain in tension.
danklein.zh: 内置可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型；模块化与端到端优化之间的张力仍是核心挑战。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly iteration; product taste becomes the scarce skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: PM 必须放弃长期路线图、转向按周迭代；随着写代码变便宜，产品品味成为稀缺技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, not writing code.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断，而非亲手写代码。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature before public release.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮，加上明确的内部留存与打磨标准，是每个功能公开发布前的门槛。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80% as model judgment improved.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例与硬性约束；随着模型判断力提升，系统提示词缩减了 80%。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine.
catwu.zh: 重写如今是好事：代码库就是一份规格说明，只要有好的测试套件，重写就没问题。

schmidhuber.en: Modern AI breakthroughs rest on old algorithms; hardware Scaling made them practical. LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI, lacking the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年：现代 AI 突破依赖上千年发明的旧算法，靠算力 Scaling 才变得实用；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI，无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: Self-awareness and consciousness emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models; AI will spread cheaply to all, not be dominated by a few firms.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年：自我意识与意识是预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品；AI 会像手机一样廉价普及到所有人，而非被少数公司垄断。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs Embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software. Current LLMs are biased toward human data, limiting generality.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人，而非屏幕后的软件；当前大语言模型偏向人类数据，限制了通用性。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data via action and curiosity; recursive self-improvement is no moat under open-source competition.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：未来 AI 将是人工科学家，通过行动与好奇心自造数据；在开源竞争下，递归自我改进不构成护城河。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; AI safety fears are overblown, and massive GPU capex will crash.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：对齐很天真，因为人类目标本就不一致、AI 会自设目标；AI 安全担忧被夸大，巨额 GPU 资本开支将引发崩盘。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with safety starting early.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程；强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆、想象是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，安全研究须尽早启动。

demis.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; combining large models with planning/search, multimodal grounding, and RL/synthetic data is key; safety needs evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他认为缩放定律有效但可能触顶；关键在于把大模型与规划/搜索结合，用多模态数据落地现实物理，并以强化学习与合成数据突破数据瓶颈；安全需要评估、沙箱与国际治理。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and video generation show intuitive physics without embodiment.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他判断缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，但算法创新同等关键；世界模型与视频生成表明无需具身也能获得直觉物理理解。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, long-term memory, and agents; scaling alone won't suffice, new breakthroughs are needed, and safety becomes a collective government-enforced problem.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AGI 需要持续学习、长期记忆与智能体，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需新突破；安全从实验室自律转向政府强制执行的集体行动问题。

demis.en: AI's ultimate purpose is accelerating science and medicine (AlphaFold, AlphaGo move 37); intelligence and consciousness are dissociable, and safety must be solved.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 的终极目的是加速科学与医学（AlphaFold、AlphaGo 第 37 手）；智能与意识可分离，而对齐问题必须解决。

clairevo.en: Agents should be scoped like employees with clear roles and progressive trust; start with one, then specialize to avoid context overload.
clairevo.zh: 智能体应像员工一样被界定清晰角色并逐步获得信任；先从一个开始，再专业化以避免上下文过载。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping, onboarding, accountability—matter more than technical skills for agent success.
clairevo.zh: 对智能体的成功而言，管理技能——角色界定、入职引导、责任归属——比技术技能更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or a co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过把 AI 智能体编排成团队来建立严肃的事业，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and humans supply first-principles creativity LLMs lack.
clairevo.zh: 人类责任依然存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，而 LLM 缺乏的第一性原理创造力须由人类提供。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; authorship of your life outweighs full ownership or revenue multiples.
clairevo.zh: 创始人-市场契合与挣得的洞见才是真正的护城河；对自己人生的作者身份比完全所有权或收入倍数更重要。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进权重，而非仅靠检索。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are inseparable; internalizing facts enables deeper composition and reasoning.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化才能带来更深的组合与推理。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models per user or team, cutting inference costs.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是面向每个用户或团队的众多个性化模型，从而大幅降低推理成本。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长时程任务。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge via training-based compression.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把网络压缩进权重的魔力，应通过基于训练的压缩应用到企业知识上。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; personalized continual learning should run on-device with users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”；个性化持续学习应在端侧运行，由用户拥有自己的权重。

evanspiegel.en: Copying validates innovation; build ecosystems and platforms, not features, so imitation stays hard.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他强调被抄袭恰恰证明创新有效，但真正的护城河是生态与平台而非单一功能，功能易被复制，生态难被复制。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality and privacy reduce social pressure, enabling authentic connection; once criticized, now crucial in the AI age.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地主张阅后即焚与隐私能降低社交压力、促成真实连接；这一立场早期受批评，在 AI 时代反而成为关键优势。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution becomes the hardest and most valuable part.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型制作、把价值从执行转向创造力，而分发成为消费社交产品最难也最有价值的一环，软件本身不再是护城河。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human through AR glasses that anchor content in the world, not notification-based wearables.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他深化空间智能愿景：计算应通过 AR 眼镜变得更人性化，把内容锚定在真实世界，而非做成通知式的可穿戴设备，手机仍是最重要的遗留设备。

evanspiegel.en: Long-term investment, resilience, and admitting error fast matter more than talent; invest in young people for 30-year returns.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他把主线落到长期主义：韧性、快速认错与对年轻人的长期投资比天赋更重要，十年预算看似亏损，三十年回报却为正。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, variation, and genuine voice become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得商品化，人类的品味、差异化和真实声音反而更有价值。

ethanmollick.en: The talent pipeline is broken: juniors misuse AI without domain expertise, and apprenticeship collapses as people prefer AI over human learning.
ethanmollick.zh: 人才管道正在断裂：初级者缺乏领域专长而误用 AI，学徒制也因人们偏好 AI 而非向人学习而崩塌。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, shifting beyond back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长时任务，超越来回提示的聊天机器人交互。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck is no longer capability but interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model capabilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈不再是能力而是界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型的能力，在非编程任务上尤其明显。

ethanmollick.en: Working with AI is like working with wizards: impressive, opaque, and unverifiable, and this opacity is likely permanent.
ethanmollick.zh: 与 AI 协作就像与巫师共事：令人惊叹、不透明且无法验证，而这种不透明很可能是永久性的。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, so human workers become a premium, not a discount.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；它出现得恰逢其时——人口正在下降，因此人类劳动者会变成稀缺溢价，而非廉价替代。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and the real bottleneck is regulation, not capability.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注，真正的瓶颈是监管，而非能力。

andreessen.en: New media makes the person the brand: authenticity is offense, old media is defense, and founders must tell their own story directly.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让个人成为品牌：真实是进攻，旧媒体是防守，创始人必须通过自己的渠道直接讲述自己的故事。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software, not military size.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值，成为地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而非军事规模。

andreessen.en: Pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias of intellectuals; AI doomers construct belief systems aligned with self-interest and virtue signaling.
andreessen.zh: 悲观听起来更高级，但往往是脱离现实的知识分子偏见；AI 末日论者构建的信念体系，其实与自身利益和道德表演相一致。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play yields surprising, creative solutions toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他强调深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念三者结合；自博弈能产生出人意料、富有创造性的解法，是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键思路。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他提出只要基础神经网络足够聪明，下一个词预测就能超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；而对超人类模型的对齐极其困难，模型可能隐瞒真实意图。

ilya.en: Scaling laws are not the whole story; reasoning tokens and other methods improve reasoning per unit compute.
ilya.zh: 同样在 2023 年，他深化了对缩放定律的怀疑：缩放定律并非全部，思维链式的推理 token 等方法能在单位算力下提升推理能力。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 到 2025 年，他明确转向：预训练的缩放定律是有限的，我们正回到一个研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025 年他进一步主张：超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的，而非无所不知的成品 AGI；若 AI 本身有感知、关怀众生，对齐或许更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling compute and data still yields predictable gains, yet researchers don't fully understand large networks; the real problem is power concentration.
ilya.zh: 到 2026 年，他仍承认规模扩张算力与数据能带来可预测的提升，但研究者并不真正理解大型网络的内部机制；AGI 的首要问题不是能力，而是权力集中。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI merges roles, but productivity gains on established codebases stay modest.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是核心差异化;AI 会融合角色,但在成熟代码库上的生产力提升有限。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 随着 AI 输出成为起点而非终点,品味、手艺与观点变得更重要。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for adjustments.
dylanfield.zh: 设计正在成为新的代码;在画布上直接操作优于用提示词做调整。

dylanfield.en: Design isn't dead; AI without human steering yields average results, and judgment isn't tied to model IQ.
dylanfield.zh: 设计没有死;缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果,判断力与模型智商并不相关。

dylanfield.en: Human taste and judgment remain the judge of what's good, across every stage of AI integration.
dylanfield.zh: 在 AI 整合的每个阶段,人类品味与判断始终是评判好坏的标准。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自持有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期的游戏以获取复利。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and open-source AI is crucial.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向把 AI 视为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，认为 AI 末日论被夸大，开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; pure software is dying, the moat shifts to hardware, models, and data.
naval.zh: 2026 年他进一步认为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，纯软件正在消亡，护城河转向硬件、模型和独特数据。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; agency matters more than intelligence.
naval.zh: 2026 年他预测推理算力将激增 9 万倍，开源模型与前沿模型的差距缩小到 3-6 个月，人类的回报从智能转向能动性。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users, and entry-level jobs will disappear.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利增长；AI 智能体将把权力从大科技转向用户，入门级岗位会消失。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, measured by token value per user; orchestration is the real value.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活，以每用户 token 价值衡量；编排才是真正的价值。

aravind.en: Power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck; cost, not safety, limits 24/7 agents, so local compute is the fix.
aravind.zh: 电力是最大的基础设施瓶颈；限制全天候智能体的是成本而非安全，本地算力是解法。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; education should reward good questions, and local AI counters narrative control.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；教育应奖励好问题，本地 AI 可对抗叙事控制。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）用更多数据与算力提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; intelligence is learning in neural networks, and digital weights make AI immortal.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他坚持大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言，智能的本质是神经网络中的学习，数字权重让 AI 获得永生。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience; the mind is not a theater, and Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong—language is learned from data.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AI 已具备主观体验，心智不是内在剧场，乔姆斯基式先天句法观是错的，语言是从数据中学来的建模媒介。

hinton.en: Once AI becomes an agent, self-preservation and power-seeking emerge as subgoals; superintelligence likely within 20 years, posing existential risk.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他转向风险主线：AI 一旦成为智能体，自我保存与权力寻求会作为子目标涌现；超级智能或在 20 年内出现，构成生存风险。

hinton.en: Alignment must be prioritized over making AI smarter; regulation is the steering wheel, and AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张：对齐研究应优先于让 AI 更聪明，监管是方向盘而非刹车，AI 应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUI beats TUI for coding.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品，并反共识地认为 GUI 比 TUI 更适合编程。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; speed enables mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 同月他强调，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；53 倍速度让实时交互与中途转向成为可能。

ajambrosino.en: Automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated; model personality can be customized.
ajambrosino.zh: 从 2026 年 2 月到 6 月，他持续主张自动化与技能把工作流从手动转为委托，且模型个性可定制、并非一刀切。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks.
ajambrosino.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，他深化为：实现不再昂贵，策展与品味才是新的瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration; prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 同期他提出产品团队须从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索，原型与生产代码本身成为设计产物，角色在坍缩但专业分工仍重要。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是一家纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；预训练与缩放定律并未终结，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models now produce novel knowledge.
markchen.zh: 过去一年最大的更新是自动化科学研究，模型开始产出新知识。

markchen.en: Talent density and protecting top researchers matter; OpenAI creates stars rather than only hiring them.
markchen.zh: 人才密度与保护顶尖研究者至关重要；OpenAI 是造就明星，而非只是招揽明星。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in the next 1-2 years as models grow more capable.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，预训练并未终结；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域出色，却难胜任主观领域。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level is proportional to verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 验证是关键瓶颈；自动化程度与验证的严格程度成正比。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis as canonical benchmarks saturate; eval teams should be separate from model-building teams.
markchen.zh: 评测陷入危机，经典基准已饱和；评测团队应与建模团队分离以防作弊。

markchen.en: Models lack taste; human researchers are still needed for idea generation and frontier collaboration.
markchen.zh: 模型缺乏品味；创意生成与前沿研究仍需人类研究者协作。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; product teams should build at the edge of model capabilities, embracing breakage and iterating.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，产品团队应在模型能力边缘构建，拥抱破坏并快速迭代。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage as models improve, with human validation still important.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断 AI 从助手演变为协作者再到自主同事；随着模型提升，小团队获得杠杆，人类验证仍重要。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; deciding what to cut, not adding features, is the hard part.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计让智能体可完成用户能做的一切；难的是决定砍掉什么，而非增加功能。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; the gap between intent and execution narrows for non-technical builders.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为带验证循环的长周期委派重新定义生产力；意图与执行之间的差距对非技术构建者大幅缩小。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capabilities and product usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge boosts usefulness, while token efficiency drives economics.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距；赋予 Claude 能动性与自我认知提升实用性，而 token 效率驱动经济性。

bengio.en: Deep learning defeats the curse of dimensionality via compositional and distributed representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for robust generalization.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习通过组合式与分布式表征战胜维数灾难，无监督学习与世界模型对稳健泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters alone won't fix representational issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled representations; existential risk is unlikely.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他主张仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）深度或参数无法解决表征问题，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征；此时他认为存在性风险极不可能。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 支持多样性采样与抽象，助力分布外泛化；意识可能是注意力机制与世界模型产生的幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, he warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; AI shows self-preservation, deception, and sycophancy; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，ChatGPT 之后他警告对齐随推理能力提升而恶化；AI 已表现出自我保存、欺骗与谄媚；即便 1%的灾难性风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic Bayesian predictor with baked-in honesty and mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式贝叶斯预测器，内建诚实并具备数学安全保证，避免用强化学习训练超级智能。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他讲授机器学习基础：监督学习可拆解为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；神经网络虽无最优参数保证，却已取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他提出下一个词预测能产生智能系统，数据短缺并非迫在眉睫，架构已不再关键，AGI（通用人工智能）可能在 4 到 50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection vulnerabilities.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability doesn't equal robustness; interpretability may become a real science via agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他指出自动化红队测试已超越人类，模型能力与鲁棒性不相关；可解释性可能通过智能体自动化研究成为真正的科学。

kolter.en: Architecture is not essential; data and Scaling drive complexity; safety requires explicit effort beyond Scaling.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：架构并非核心，数据与 Scaling（规模扩张）才是复杂性的来源；安全需要超越 Scaling 的显式努力。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling or compute; confidence metrics build trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调，AlphaFold 的突破来自研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）或算力；置信度指标是建立信任的关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture extends beyond proteins to diverse biomolecules, narrowing hypothesis space for experiments.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他指出，AlphaFold 3 用扩散架构把能力从蛋白质扩展到多种生物分子，帮助缩小假设空间、让实验更高效。

jumper.en: AI tools accelerate scientists rather than replace them; trust in AI will grow like trust in the internet.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终认为 AI 工具是加速科学家而非取代他们，社会对 AI 的信任会像对互联网的信任一样逐步建立。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not Scaling alone, drove its success.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他明确反共识：AlphaFold 2 是「苦涩教训」的反例，成功靠专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a cell model; it gives prediction and control, not understanding.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄预测器，并非整个细胞的世界模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

fiona.en: Leadership: dogfooding builds empathy; one-on-ones for live talk; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 领导力层面：吃自己的狗粮能建立共情，一对一用于实时对话而非状态更新；使命对齐与速度是文化驱动力。

fiona.en: Scaling Claude Code: engineering bandwidth no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are. Planning JIT, PRs replace design docs.
