fiona.zh: Scaling Claude Code：工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是。规划变为即时制，PR 取代设计文档。

fiona.en: Code is source of truth; docs sync with AI help. Managers start as ICs to dogfood; kill old processes; flat orgs.
fiona.zh: 代码是唯一事实来源，文档借助 AI 保持同步。管理者从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮；砍掉过时流程；组织尽量扁平。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with high accountability key. Verification and quality frameworks matter more as code velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责制是关键。随着代码速度提升，验证与质量框架更重要。

fiona.en: AI era: growth mindset and leaning into AI essential. Engineers may feel lonely with agents; flow state lost; outcomes over output.
fiona.zh: AI 时代：成长心态与拥抱 AI 至关重要。工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独；心流状态消失；关注结果而非产出。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not inferior to data.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于未被言说的人类需求；直觉是一种智能，并不逊于数据。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think, and art is medicine.
ivyross.zh: 大自然是最好设计师；我们是先感受后思考的生物，艺术即良药。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must create conditions for play and inspiration.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下繁荣；领导者必须为玩耍和灵感创造条件。

ivyross.en: Intuition and body sensations are valid decision guides, complementing rational analysis throughout.
ivyross.zh: 直觉和身体感受是有效的决策指南，始终与理性分析互补。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity; future work blends human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大人类特质；未来工作融合人类创造力与 AI，使创造技能更有价值。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain, not everything; technology must arrive gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：好产品只解决一个痛点，而非包揽一切；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应——General Magic 因一次解决太多问题而失败。

fadell.en: Storytelling and the press release define the product; failure and boredom between chapters breed clarity.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事从营销工具升格为产品定义方法：先写新闻稿再动手，失败是学习机会，职业章节之间的无聊期反而催生清晰与灵感。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1, beginners' mindset over experts, and marketing involved from the start.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他深化产品方法论：1.0 版本靠观点而非数据决策，初学者心态胜过专家，营销必须从第一天就参与，而非事后讲故事。

fadell.en: Climate urgency and deep tech investing persist; downturns are pendulum swings, be greedy when others fear.
fadell.zh: 从 2022 到 2026 年，气候紧迫性与深科技投资的主线一以贯之：低谷是钟摆，别人恐惧时出手，绿色产业是未来。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and humans in the loop; wearables will be a federated set, not one device.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：LLM 有幻觉等根本问题，需情境化模型；AI 可穿戴不会是单一设备，而是联邦式组合，手机仍是最佳单一形态，人必须留在回路中以避免技术债。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能离不开学习，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，并指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, and world models are learned, not hardwired.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他深化观点：自监督学习是智能的暗物质，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），世界模型是习得的而非硬编码的。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for gradual AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确批评自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理和规划，主张 JEPA 和开源，认为 AGI 是渐进过程。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA for reasoning and planning.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他进一步断言 LLM 不如家猫聪明，下一代突破需要基于 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型来实现推理和规划。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven agents.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他总结 LLM 是死胡同，世界模型在抽象表征空间预测才能实现安全、目标驱动的智能体，并强调开源和物理世界理解。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via 10x yearly compute scaling; Google sat on ChatGPT-level tech since 2020.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：AI 进步因算力每年 10 倍增长而高度可预测，谷歌早在 2020 年就握有 ChatGPT 级技术却因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimal.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平，模型变小变便宜使遏制极难，而生存风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Focus shifts to containment and alignment before release; superintelligence must stay on our team.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年重心转向发布前的遏制与对齐，提出超级智能必须始终站在人类一边，并强调遏制优先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Agents and companions replace OS and apps; modern Turing test measures economic value.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他主张从操作系统、应用转向智能体与伴侣，现代图灵测试应以经济价值衡量。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; tasks, not jobs, get automated in 12-18 months.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他坚持微软须自建前沿模型实现自给，并称 12-18 个月内被自动化的是任务而非整个工作。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是确定性的下一个词预测器，智能即压缩，模型价值观并非固有，而是通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人植入的。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product requiring fault-tolerant UI.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展转向推荐再转向生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品，需要容错型用户界面来匹配算法性能。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must reposition to surf it, but current impact on big firms is overhyped.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他将 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，公司必须重新定位以冲浪其中，但当前对大公司的影响被夸大了，真正的收益来自重建基础设施。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables two-way conversational products; exposing data via APIs and MCP lets non-developers use AI tools.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他认为生成式 AI 使产品能双向对话，通过 API 和 MCP 暴露公司数据，让非开发者也能使用 AI 工具。

gustav.en: No single org model; long tenure builds trust. AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他主张没有唯一正确的组织模型，长期任期建立信任；AI 应让用户控制算法，而非使其更上瘾，这是反共识的押注。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is when people do unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们做自己看重的独特事情，而非基准分数；私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency matters, and private evals let companies hill-climb without leaking traces.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率至关重要，而私有评估让企业能在不泄露痕迹的情况下爬坡。

satya.en: The platform promise is enabling every company to operate at the frontier with their own intelligence, not building firewalls for sovereign AI.
satya.zh: 平台承诺是让每家公司都能用自己的智能在前沿运营，而不是为主权 AI 建造防火墙。

satya.en: Security, containment, manageability, and observability are critical for agent deployment; the biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training.
satya.zh: 安全、遏制、可管理性和可观测性对智能体部署至关重要；最大的风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露。

carinahong.en: Axiom builds a self-improving reasoning engine pairing generation with verification, starting with an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 构建一个自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与验证结合起来，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; verified generation beats informal methods.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证是在规模化卓越，而不只是消除错误；经过验证的生成优于非形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠非形式化数学系统无法扩展到超级智能；形式化方法是必要的。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving, and harder than auto-informalization, due to lack of grounding.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难，也比自动非形式化更难，因为缺乏根基。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 即便 AI 能超人类地证明定理，人类的品味与直觉依然至关重要。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world, with public feedback, is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调把 AI 部署到真实世界、接受公众反馈，是学习与对齐的关键；安全必须在公开中做，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Scaling laws and one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 从 2023 到 2026，她始终回望 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律早期并非显而易见，把 GPT-3 以 API 发布是一次没有清晰商业模式的信仰之跃。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年，她的重心从部署转向交互模型：应是基于时间而非轮次，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; durable progress beats compressing frontier AI progress.
murati.zh: 2026 年她深化对齐立场：尽可能长久地把人类留在回路中，追求持久进步，而非把前沿模型的进展压缩在短时间内。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; governance, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：未来并非注定，我们有能动性；制度设计、透明度与制衡，比个人品格更重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer; VM sandbox gives safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；VM 沙箱提供安全与保障。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may matter less as models improve; invest in capabilities and safety instead.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型进步，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；关键是把投入放在能力与安全上。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 最大的鸿沟不是 AI 能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use AI for tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; ideal interaction is asynchronous.
felixrieseberg.zh: 用 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，把人类解放出来做创造性工作；理想的交互是异步的。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact, and debug the workflow with Claude when it errs.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude；只看最终影响，出错时和 Claude 一起调试工作流，而非只做纠正。

mensch.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他认为缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量与更多 token 比单纯做大模型更重要；开源通过广泛审视促进安全。

mensch.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：算力扩张不是唯一路径，效率与数据质量同等关键，价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises, and AI augments rather than replaces jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向主权与去中心化：开源模型赋能企业，AI 增强而非取代工作，政府应拥抱风险并实验。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, customization, and agentic enterprise software with human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他进一步判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化、定制化与带人类在环的智能体式企业软件。

mensch.en: Open source, data quality, and European strategic autonomy are consistent threads across his thinking.
mensch.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是开源、数据质量与欧洲战略自主。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute, but progress is a smooth exponential, not a slowdown.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在单位算力上带来更多收益；AI 进步是平滑的指数增长，而非放缓。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models shifted focus from scaling up; distillation and economics, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他指出部署更小、更便宜模型的经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转移；是蒸馏和经济因素，而非技术极限，拖慢了预训练 Scaling。

kaiser.en: Multimodal capabilities still lag text, processing inputs sequentially like tiny patches; deep progress remains elusive despite being a key area.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为多模态能力仍落后于文本，模型像处理小图块一样顺序处理输入，深层进展依然难觅，尽管这是关键方向。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike human few-shot generalization.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，不像人类能从小样本泛化。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他强调强化学习能跨领域泛化但边缘参差，需谨慎监督；相比存在性风险，系统入侵等近期风险更紧迫。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; virtual tools can't replace in-person creative presence.
jonyive.zh: 设计正从通用计算机转向更私密的可穿戴设备，虚拟沟通无法替代面对面共创的价值。

jonyive.en: Curiosity and care are intentional disciplines, not innate traits; fragile ideas need protection from status quo pressure.
jonyive.zh: 好奇心与用心是需要刻意坚持的修养而非天赋，脆弱的创意需要被保护以免被现状同化。

jonyive.en: Simplicity expresses a product's essence, not mere clutter removal; values and purpose, not profit, should drive design.
jonyive.zh: 简洁是表达产品本质而非单纯去杂，设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润或市场潮流。

jonyive.en: Innovation must move things forward rather than break for its own sake; speed and quality need not conflict.
jonyive.zh: 创新应推动进步而非为破坏而破坏，速度与质量并非必然冲突，关键在于动机与框架。

jonyive.en: Tradition preserves fire, not ashes; authenticity means rejecting fake engine sounds and redefining performance beyond straight-line speed.
jonyive.zh: 传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬，真实体验意味着拒绝伪造引擎声，并把性能重新定义为操控而非直线加速。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominates AI design: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 设计：批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡，瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Long-context inference is limited by the memory wall, not compute, which explains context window stagnation and makes prefill cheaper than decode.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他指出，长上下文推理受内存墙而非算力限制，这解释了上下文窗口的停滞，并使预填充比解码更便宜。

reinerpope.en: Sparse attention cuts KV cache memory cost but has quality limits; optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio, not model scale.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他提出，稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存内存成本但有质量上限；最优批大小取决于稀疏比例，而非模型规模。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, now drives scaling decisions.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他认为，模型被过度训练到超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为如今驱动 Scaling 决策的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute even inside a chip; low precision and systolic arrays matter because quadratic bit-width scaling makes them efficient.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他强调，即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也压过计算成本；低精度与脉动阵列之所以重要，是因为位宽的二次方缩放使其高效。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress now needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 2024 年时他强调：预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）的回报在递减，进一步进展需要算法创新，而推理阶段的算力（思考）是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，能突破预训练瓶颈。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 他始终认为，从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是不变的核心主线。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows serve as working memory.
oriol.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续强调给模型工具（搜索、代码执行、浏览器）能实现超越静态权重的智能体式行为，而长上下文窗口充当工作记忆。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化观点：联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径，而视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; the bitter lesson favors general systems over specialized scaffolding.
oriol.zh: 2026 年他仍坚持缩放定律有效，但指出持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力，并认为苦涩的教训意味着通用系统终将胜过专用脚手架。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将延续，安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发能防止企业俘获。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithm choice; post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards.
lambert.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的重心从 RLHF 转向后训练配方：数据质量远比算法选择重要，后训练分为 SFT、DPO 与带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）三阶段。

lambert.en: RLVR is the key breakthrough for reasoning and tool use, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots mislead.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为推理与工具使用的关键突破，同时警告强化学习中的过度优化，并称推理时 Scaling 曲线是一种被高估的“错觉”。

lambert.en: Open models, led by Chinese labs, become the engine of research; full transparency means data, checkpoints, and recipes.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张开放模型将驱动未来十年研究，中国实验室凭战略开放主导，真正的开放需透明到数据、中间检查点与配方。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference; AGI arrives via messy co-evolution.
lambert.zh: 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立但红利已尽，增益转向后训练与推理 Scaling，AGI（通用人工智能）将通过混乱的协同演化而非突变奇点到来。

askell.en: Treat AI models well even if their moral status is uncertain, because the cost is low and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
askell.zh: 即便不确定 AI 模型的道德地位，也应善待它们，因为代价很低，而且未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating their novel existence rather than simply applying human psychology analogies to their situation.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对自身这种全新的存在处境，而不是简单套用人类心理学的类比。

askell.en: Models should have a core identity with good traits, while philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities.
askell.zh: 模型应拥有具备良好特质的核心身份，同时哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, making it a unique, childlike entity.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据和微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，使其成为一个独特的、带有孩童般特质的实体。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution may need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment, though excessive corrigibility could be risky.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式引导或许需要更少的显式指导、更多判断空间，但过度的可纠正性可能带来风险。

karpathy.en: Neural nets are simple math with many knobs; Scaling next-token prediction on internet data yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 神经网络只是带许多旋钮的简单数学表达式，但在难题上优化会产生惊人的涌现行为；用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling 会带来上下文学习等涌现能力。

karpathy.en: Transformer enables clean scaling laws; synthetic data is future but entropy must be kept to avoid silent model collapse.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机，能实现干净的缩放定律；合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context window as memory; LLMs are operating systems with human-like psychology, not utilities.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 不是工具，而是具有类人心理的操作系统。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; this is the decade of agents, needing a decade to fix continual learning and multimodality.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；这是智能体的十年而非一年，需要十年克服持续学习与多模态等认知缺陷。

karpathy.en: Since December I haven't typed code; bottleneck is skill in directing agents. Vibe coding raises floor, agentic engineering keeps quality.
karpathy.zh: 自十二月起我没敲过一行代码，瓶颈已从打字速度变为指挥智能体的技能；Vibe coding 抬高下限，智能体式工程守住专业质量。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from a solution, not a problem, and designers should trust intuition over process.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已经过时；伟大的作品往往从解决方案而非问题出发，设计师应信任直觉而非流程。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead due to AI; designers now mock up 30-40% of the time and must help engineers execute, not just hand off.
jennywen.zh: 研究—发散—收敛的流程因 AI 而消亡；设计师现在只有 30-40% 的时间做原型，且必须帮助工程师执行，而非仅交付稿。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years; trust is built through speed—ship early, iterate fast, respond to feedback.
jennywen.zh: 设计愿景现在只看 3-6 个月，而非 2-5 年；信任靠速度建立——尽早发布、快速迭代、回应反馈。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; taste alone won't save designers—judgment, authority, and vision matter.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和天赋异禀的新人；仅靠品味救不了设计师——判断力、权威和愿景才是关键。

jennywen.en: Designers control how much AI enters their work and should wait 6 months before adopting new tools, keeping work and users—not AI hype—at the center.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 进入工作的程度，并应在新工具出现后等 6 个月再采用，让作品和用户而非 AI 炒作处于中心。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, drives it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为超越训练分布的泛化能力是机器学习缺失的核心，靠无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索而非密集奖励来实现，并强调样本效率与跨机器人泛化。

pathak.en: Robot learning must move from quasi-static tasks to dynamic motion via neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他主张机器人学习要从准静态任务走向动态任务，用神经动态策略与模块化运动策略实现平滑动态运动和对新形态的零样本泛化。

pathak.en: A consistent thread: data and generalization, not algorithms alone, are the bottleneck for embodied intelligence.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：具身智能的瓶颈是数据与泛化，而非单纯算法；早期用好奇心与仿真补数据，后期转向多源数据预训练。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so pretrain on videos and simulation, then post-train on real-world data.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他把机器人重新定义为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，因此要用视频与仿真做预训练，再用真实世界数据做后训练。

pathak.en: Shift in emphasis: from curiosity-driven exploration to a general-purpose brain and a data flywheel; deployment, not scaling, is the hard part.
pathak.zh: 2026 年立场深化与转变：从好奇心驱动探索转向通用大脑与数据飞轮，并强调部署本身才是技术难题，机器人无法像软件那样一夜扩张。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; modern tools make them interpretable, contrary to past belief.
kendall.zh: 端到端神经网络胜过手工编码的流水线；借助现代工具它们已可解释，这与过去的看法相反。

kendall.en: Generalization via diverse data and world models is key; scaling current approaches solves driving without new breakthroughs.
kendall.zh: 通过多样数据和世界模型实现泛化是关键；靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and human interaction; camera-only reaches human level, beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 语言整合提升表征、推理与人机交互；纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; this lesson was learned late.
kendall.zh: 基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更重要；这一教训是后来才领悟的。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 消费级车辆将在规模上超过 Robotaxi；无需先验训练数据即可实现 500 多座城市的零样本泛化。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not one event; scaling reasoning models accelerates progress; alignment is pressing as systems grow more powerful.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一连串里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展；随着系统变强，对齐成为紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment and early governance design let labs learn and mitigate real-world risks before capabilities outrun oversight.
pachocki.zh: 迭代部署与早期治理设计，让实验室在能力超出监督之前，于真实使用中学习并缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Measuring capabilities is a bottleneck; benchmarks lag, AGI term is becoming meaningless, and safety progress is now driven by capability needs.
pachocki.zh: 能力测量正成为瓶颈，基准落后，AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，安全进展如今由能力需求而非仅伦理驱动。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices, so specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习已足够，专设持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is key to alignment and interpretability; hiding it in products preserves that value as models act autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是对齐与可解释性的关键；在产品中隐藏思维链才能保住这一价值，因为模型将自主运行数天。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; the model is the product, iterated like software with daily shipping to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他认为 ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的，模型即产品，必须像软件一样迭代，通过每日发布来了解用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and we haven't built Windows yet—the interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他提出聊天不是未来，它就像 MS-DOS，我们还没造出 Windows——界面将超越逐轮聊天。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他强调安全与产品速度必须分开；前沿模型需严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他指出 ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他认为下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富含可供性的产品；推理模型无缝产品化后将带来变革。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调：高质量数据与人类评估而非基准才是真正进步的标尺，强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，仅靠 LLM 与下一个词预测可能无法抵达，需要新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function; there will be no single model, and every company should train its own.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他指出前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型统治一切，每家公司终将训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: Consistent thread: quality requires taste and creativity, not credentials; benchmarks like Elo can be gamed into slop.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：质量靠品味与创造力而非资历，Elo 等基准可被博弈，导向低质内容。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment matters more than ever; safety over accuracy, and omission may be the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他深化到医学：人类判断比以往更关键，安全优先于准确，遗漏可能是最大风险。

carlpei.en: Startups must survive first, start simple, and build brand as core, not afterthought; hardware can be easier than software.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调创业公司先求生存、从简单产品起步，品牌建设是核心而非事后补充；并抛出反共识判断：硬件比软件更容易，因为软件如今的分发更难。

carlpei.en: Phones' future is generative UI and proactive agentic software; AI models commoditize, so applied AI and trust matter.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他把手机未来押注在生成式 UI 与主动的智能体式软件上，认为 AI 模型正走向商品化，胜负在于面向消费者的应用型 AI 与信任安全。

carlpei.en: Hardware margins are lowest; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware while using content creation as marketing arbitrage.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他反复强调硬件利润率最低、Nothing 必须超越硬件，同时把内容创作当作营销套利与核心竞争优势。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; AI should be an ingredient, not a hype topic.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：在成熟品类中设计是最快的差异化手段，AI 应像屏幕一样只是提升体验的原料，不该被当作炒作话题。

carlpei.en: Smartphones shift from app-based to intent-based with agents; only brain-computer interfaces could replace them.
carlpei.zh: 最近他判断手机将从基于应用转向基于意图、由智能体执行任务，并坚持只有脑机接口才可能取代手机，眼镜等可穿戴设备不行。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs hint at AGI, and video learning can train agents without costly RL.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为像显微镜一样延伸人类能力的工具；认为把一切输入 token 化的通用智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步，并主张用视频学习替代昂贵的强化学习来训练智能体。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion are essential to beneficial AI; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, not only large models.
nando.zh: 2023 年他强调，多元与包容是造出有益技术的前提，基础创新可以来自任何地方，大模型并非全部。

nando.en: The goal is AI that augments scientists and workers, creating new symbols and knowledge, not just scaling existing models.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他的一贯主线是：AI 应增强科学家与劳动者、创造新符号与新知识，而非只做 Scaling（规模扩张）。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; safety remains an open problem without solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心明显转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，直言安全仍是尚无解法的开放问题。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI; it leapfrogs legacy gaps, and language models can transform local-language education.
nando.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张非洲在 AI 上并不落后，反而能跨越历史包袱，语言模型可变革本地语言教育。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to maximize broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响；AlphaFold 3 从蛋白质结构扩展到蛋白质、DNA、RNA 与小分子的生物分子相互作用，正是这一思路的体现。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出大语言模型的幻觉在配合真实性检测器时，反而能被用于创造性发现，FunSearch 用 LLM 发现新算法、AlphaGeometry 解出国际数学奥林匹克几何题都是例证。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, via hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调必须用高难度评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化而非记忆；DeepMind 刻意避开顶尖大学能解决的问题，专注需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的问题。

kohli.en: Material science is more experimental than biology; AI impact there will take 5-10 years.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他判断材料科学比生物学更依赖实验，AI 在材料领域的影响需要 5 到 10 年；GNOME 发现 220 万种新稳定无机材料虽改变格局，但实用性仍未知。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化：后训练结合强化学习已成为突破人类知识边界的关键；AlphaGo 的搜索技术被用于矩阵乘法等科学问题，AlphaTensor 发现了人类 50 年未找到的算法。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他提出大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，却难以超越人类数据；可验证领域如代码对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要，而 AlphaGo 标志着 AI 在特定领域超越人类智能的转折点。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他明确可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需；AI 能产出正确却不可解释的证明，挑战人类理解，但 AlphaGo 优化胜率而非分差也带来反直觉的终局下法。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: it grounds knowledge, reduces hallucinations, and provides infinite data beyond the internet's finite tokens.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：它为知识提供基础、减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 耗尽后提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs are operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are the hard disk; RL is only a cherry on top.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他将 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习才是主力。

jimfan.en: From 2023 to 2026, his focus shifts from general embodiment to robotics' data bottleneck, where synthetic data and world models become the scaling path.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他的关注点从泛具身转向机器人领域的数据瓶颈，合成数据与世界模型成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的关键路径。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test—a robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他认为一个能利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键；物理图灵测试——机器人打扫凌乱的房子——是终极挑战。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning progresses well, but system one low-level control remains hardest; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他指出系统二（推理）进展顺利，但系统一（低级控制）仍是最难的部分；机器人的 GPT-3 时刻大约在五年后到来。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence. Fine-tuning may become obsolete as context and adaptive compute enable dynamic specialization.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能；随着上下文窗口与自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis beyond pre-training; models learn new skills, not just elicit knowledge. Reliability, not capability, is the agent bar.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是预训练之外的新缩放轴，模型能学到新能力而非仅调取已有知识；智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL is likely sufficient for AGI; no new architecture needed. Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain due to verifiability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练加强化学习可能足以通向 AGI，无需新架构；编码因可验证性成为 AI 进展的领先指标与最可行领域。

sholto.en: Inference compute becomes the major bottleneck by 2028; compute is the new oil, chip supply the current constraint. Progress is exponential, not plateauing.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化算力主线：推理算力将在 2028 年前成为主要瓶颈，算力是“新石油”、芯片供应是当前约束；进展是指数级的，并未见顶。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence now; work becomes managing fleets of agents. World models are not on the critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他转向能力过剩论：当下编排比原始智能更重要，工作是管理智能体集群；世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上，编码与 AI 研究才是直接路线。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems while treating AI as a creative partner.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师、对齐问题，并把 AI 当作创作伙伴。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and gets paid off iteratively alongside technical debt through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：它会波动，需通过快速、草率的实验与短迭代周期，和技术债一起逐步偿还。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth, as AI merges design and engineering further.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互通的，以代码为真相来源，AI 会进一步融合设计与工程。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams beat 8-10 person squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；小团队胜过 8-10 人的跨职能小队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成预期；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; Scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她强调预训练提供广度，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是安全可用的关键；同时质疑仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题，并认为下一个词预测的预训练目标与人类学习根本错位。

yejin.en: Inference-time algorithms and high-quality synthetic data can boost smaller models; language is the best medium for reasoning, but AI safety faces value pluralism.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她提出推理阶段的算法与高质量合成数据能让更小模型比肩大模型；语言是推理的最佳媒介，但 AI 安全因价值多元而成为棘手的计算问题。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. RL requires careful engineering, and open research is crucial.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，她将数据视为根本瓶颈，指出当前 AI 只是插值人类知识而非超越；强化学习需要精细工程才能超越监督微调，并强调开放研究对 AI 民主化至关重要。

yejin.en: Abductive reasoning is key to scientific discovery; falsification matters more than hypothesis generation. AI must explore unknown knowledge beyond human knowledge.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，她认为溯因推理是科学发现的关键，证伪比假设生成更重要；AI 需要探索人类知识之外的未知领域，否则可能沦为 AI 服务 AI 或人类服务 AI。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; RL during pre-training improves reasoning; pluralistic alignment respects diverse values.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，她进一步论证小语言模型借助高质量、多样化的合成数据可以很强大；预训练阶段的强化学习能通过奖励信息增益提升推理；多元对齐比消除互联网偏见更可行。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning; don't innovate on interaction design.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当写代码以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本；不要在交互设计上创新，沿用熟悉模式以换取速度。

henrymodisett.en: Design systems are semantic and code reuse matters, not Figma libraries; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他提出设计系统是语义性的，关键是代码复用而非 Figma 库；并非每个界面都要做到完美，应按 ROI 决定何处做到极致。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should prioritize recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines should be dynamic platforms for expression.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他认为初创公司的品牌战略应优先服务于招聘与差异化；品牌规范应是供设计师表达自我的动态平台。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, and give designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计提升为战略武器：创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并给设计师所有权与自主权，让他们做决策、成长。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool—invest early to attract diverse talent and stand out.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化品牌观：人们加入的是品牌而非公司，品牌叙事是招聘工具；应尽早投资品牌，以吸引多元人才并脱颖而出。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness beat perfection; avoid structured crits, adapt process to the problem, and gut decisions often beat data in fast startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他延续速度主线并更激进：速度与果断胜过完美，避免结构化评审，让流程适配问题；在快速增长的初创公司里，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

truell.en: Scaling laws still drive predictable AI progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年时他仍相信缩放定律带来可预测的进步，但已预判测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration, not full autonomy, remains central.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体虽前景可期但尚不实用，迭代式人机协作而非完全自主仍是核心。

truell.en: The editor is becoming an AI-integrated environment, and programming is shifting from code toward higher-level intent specification.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的判断从“编辑器进化为 AI 集成环境”深化为“编程正从写代码转向更高层的意图表达”。

truell.en: Custom models became essential to product quality and speed, a shift from relying on frontier models alone.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年，他转向认为自研定制模型对产品质量与速度不可或缺，不再只依赖前沿模型。

truell.en: Taste and logic design will matter more than carefulness; the AI shift exceeds the internet and unfolds over decades.
truell.zh: 2025 年他进一步提出，品味与逻辑设计将比谨慎更重要，AI 变革比互联网更深远且需数十年展开。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction; Scaling compute and data yields smarter AI, but internals remain opaque alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年：LLM 本质是下一个词预测这一 AI-complete 问题；靠 Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让 AI 更聪明，但网络内部仍像炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app; unforeseen uses emerge, yet big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches.
shazeer.zh: 2023 到 2025 年：对话是杀手级应用，最佳用途常出乎创造者意料；但大厂受品牌风险与安全顾虑掣肘，拖慢产品发布。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute Scaling and longer context windows are the near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：推理时算力 Scaling 与更长的上下文窗口是近期最大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构支撑高效 Scaling。

shazeer.en: RL and agentic action in complex environments drive reasoning; continual learning via independently trainable modules may replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：强化学习与在复杂环境中的智能体式行动推动推理能力；由可独立训练模块实现的持续学习，可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped: test-time compute alone won't reach it, but economic impact far exceeds trillion-dollar products; coding self-accelerates progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：AGI（通用人工智能）被低估——仅靠推理时算力不足以实现，但其经济影响远超万亿美元级产品；编程作为应用被低估，它让 AI 进步自我加速。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hardware and software advances; self-play, imitation, and fine-tuned pre-training drive learning, but RL lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，机器人要击败费德勒需硬件与软件双重突破；自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型提供强学习信号，但强化学习缺乏长时程信用分配所需的分层推理。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge belongs in data generation, not hard-coded networks; pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据生成而非硬编码进网络；预训练语言模型能将通用推理模式迁移到非语言任务。

abbeel.en: A consistent line: transfer via fine-tuning large pre-trained models, and simulation/self-play as scalable learning signals for real-world robotics.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 一以贯之的主线：通过微调大型预训练模型实现迁移，并以模拟与自博弈作为可扩展的学习信号，服务于真实世界机器人。

abbeel.en: Reliability, not just capability, defines value: 99.9% reliability is the benchmark for warehouse robotics, and a single network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年立场深化：价值不只由能力定义，更由可靠性定义——99.9% 可靠性是仓储机器人的基准，且单一网络可跨任务与末端执行器泛化。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; alignment and robustness matter as capabilities grow. Talent gap exceeds funding gap; build skills first.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究仍被严重低估，随着能力提升，对齐与鲁棒性至关重要；人才缺口大于资金缺口，应先积累技能。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research are needed. Evaluation is easier than generation.
leike.zh: 到 2023 年，他判断基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，必须转向可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究，并强调评估比生成更容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment dissolved and compute promises broken. Post-training alone can't align AGI; third-party testing and regulation needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化、超级对齐团队被解散且算力承诺落空；仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），需要第三方测试与监管。

leike.en: Alignment must be empirically tested and measured now, not deferred; uncertainty about true alignment is the core risk.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：对齐必须当下就做实证测试与度量，而非推迟；对系统是否真正对齐的不确定性才是核心风险。

leike.en: From individual skill-building and collaboration to institutional critique and regulation: his focus shifted from researcher paths to systemic accountability.
leike.zh: 从 2018 年关注个人技能建设与机构合作，到 2024 年转向机构问责与监管，他的思考由研究者路径深化为系统性治理。
